tool_schemas.name: deepview
tool_schemas.description: Performs a single lifecycle operation on a DeepView server instance for the given client: deploy creates a new server instance and records a deploy event, claim associates an existing server instance with the client using a claim token and records a claim event, and release relinquishes the client’s claim on a server instance and records a release event; it returns the affected server instance and the recorded event details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, fields don’t match their formats (e.g., dvw_cli_* / dvw_srv_*), deploy includes claim-only fields or omits deploy-only inputs (region/capacity_units), claim/release omit server_instance_id, or claim omits claim_token; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not allowed to act for client_id or access the target server; raises NOT_FOUND when server_instance_id does not exist. Raises CONFLICT when request_id was already used with different parameters, when attempting to claim a server instance that is already claimed or cannot be claimed in its current state, or when attempting to release a server instance that is not currently claimed by the specified client_id or is not releasable in its current state; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the client exceeds allowed deployments/capacity.

action.description: Operation to perform on a DeepView server instance.

client_id.description: DeepView client id that owns/requests the server lifecycle action.

request_id.description: Idempotency/correlation id recorded on deploy/claim/release events.

request_context.description: Arbitrary structured context saved with the deploy/claim/release event.

region.description: Preferred deployment region for a new server instance (deploy only).

capacity_units.description: Requested capacity units for the server instance (deploy only).

server_instance_id.description: Target server instance id to claim or release (claim/release).

claim_token.description: Client-provided claim token used to claim a server instance (claim only).

tool_schemas.name: deepview_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as resolved by the presented DeepView credential, including the mapped client (if any), granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption; refuses if the credential is missing, invalid, or revoked.

api_key.description: DeepView API key presented for authentication (e.g., "dvw_key_...").

tool_schemas.name: deepview_list_server_instances
tool_schemas.description: Lists server instances visible to the calling client, with optional filtering by status, region, and client association; returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending and refuses invalid filters or unauthorized access.

api_key.description: DeepView API key used to scope results to the calling client.

client_id.description: Filter by owning client id; callers may only request their own client_id.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: deepview_get_server_instance
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single server instance by id; returns the instance if it is visible to the calling client and refuses if not found or not authorized.

api_key.description: DeepView API key used to authorize access.

tool_schemas.name: deepview_update_server_instance
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a server instance and can drive supported lifecycle transitions (e.g., mark failed or delete) when permitted; refuses invalid transitions, attempts to update immutable fields, or unauthorized access.

api_key.description: DeepView API key used to authorize the update.

status.description: Requested lifecycle transition for the instance; only allowed transitions are accepted.

expires_at.description: New expiry timestamp for the instance.

capacity_units.description: Updated capacity units for the instance (subject to allocation limits).

tool_schemas.name: deepview_list_deploy_claim_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists deploy/claim/release events for the calling client, optionally filtered by server instance, event type, result, or request_id; returns a paginated list and refuses unauthorized access.

api_key.description: DeepView API key used to scope results to the calling client.

client_id.description: Filter by client id; callers may only request their own client_id.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: deepview_update_client
tool_schemas.description: Updates client metadata and can transition a client from active to disabled; refuses attempts to re-enable a disabled client, attempts to change immutable identifiers, or unauthorized access.

api_key.description: DeepView API key used to authorize the update.

client_id.description: Client id to update; callers may only update their own client.

status.description: Lifecycle transition for the client; only active→disabled is allowed.

last_seen_at.description: Optional last-seen timestamp to record for the client.

metadata.name: DeepView
metadata.description: DeepView is an MCP-backed service that exposes a single operational tool used to deploy/claim a DeepView server instance for a client.
